subject: thm-exact-column-pivoted-qr-of-a-rank-r-matrix-has-an-invertible-leading-block-and-zero-trailing-block
description: In this published supplier, step 1.1 says: 'After $k$ pivot steps' the 'next pivot diagonal entry $r_{kk}$ is the norm of the residual' after projection onto the span of the first k chosen columns. The next pivot is indexed k+1, whereas r_kk belongs to the already selected kth column. Step 2.1 then uses k<r to conclude that 'the first $r$ diagonal entries' are nonzero, omitting the final pivot under its written indexing. Also, without a diagonal phase convention, the residual norm equals the modulus of the diagonal entry. The standard greedy-rank argument supports the theorem, but these written index and phase statements need clarification.
repair: Use the modulus of the pivot diagonal without an unstated phase convention, explicitly retain zero-based pivot indices, and derive the entire zero lower block from the chosen-column span; Statement and numerical method unchanged.

subject: cor-real-spectral-theorem-for-self-adjoint-endomorphisms
description: Step 2.1 says: “every $2\times2$ block collapses to the scalar block $[a]$.” Setting b=0 makes the displayed 2×2 block equal to aI₂, retaining two coordinates; [a] denotes a 1×1 block. The subsequent diagonality and eigenbasis conclusions remain valid, but this block-size wording is inaccurate.
